punchline: Tolle saw time on the faces of old friends after almost thirty years, and says all of it happened in a single moment.
thirty_sec: After almost thirty years, Eckhart Tolle met old friends and was shocked: the mother walked with a cane, her daughter looked worn out by three children. Time had done this to them, he thought, yet he insists it all happens in the Now. His question is whether you treat this moment as a means, an obstacle or an enemy.
